title: Siman 437
section: The Virtue of Hisbodidus — Secluded Personal Prayer

segments.he: שָׁמַעְתִּימֵאֶחָד שֶׁשָּׁמַע מֵרַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה שֶׁסִּפֵּר לוֹ מֵעצֶם הַקְּדֻשָּׁה שֶׁלּוֹ בְּיַלְדוּתוֹ, שֶׁבִּהְיוֹתוֹ יֶלֶד
segments.en: (1.) From a letter of the friends: He said it is good for a person to say during hisbodidus — when engaging in private conversation with his Creator — to say: "Today I begin to cleave to You." And he should make a new beginning each and every time — for all continuations follow from the beginnings. And even the philosophers say that the beginning is like half the entire action. It turns out from whichever way you look at it — one should make a new beginning each time and say as mentioned above. For from whichever way you look at it: if it was good before — now it will be...
